prereg.title: CB2-S2b (r5): S2 with a terminal death penalty, larger development set, 80-world sealed test
prereg.authority: DAV-91: S2 (r4) sealed NO IMPROVEMENT (37f2971); diagnosis: the reward paid nothing for staying alive. David (2026-10-09 13:04 CT): 'Let's move forward.' Sol's review of the survival term requested on DAV-91; posted here before any S2b outcome exists.

changes_from_S2.reward: training reward = the environment's reward['total'] (unchanged, logged as before) MINUS 10 at each terminal (death) step; truncated lives (10,000 steps) are not terminal. No per-step living bonus (it would pay for stalling). 10 ~ the Crafter reward of a whole typical life (~12), so dying costs about a life's achievements; with gamma 0.99 the penalty reaches ~100 steps before a death, and delaying an unavoidable death by k steps reduces it by 0.99^k.
changes_from_S2.development: 76001-76120 (120 worlds; 76001-76040 were S2 development worlds, used for selection only), at iteration 0 (r3h-B) and every 10 iterations (10, 20, 30, 40, 50) — 5 candidates instead of 10, against the winner's curse
changes_from_S2.sealed: 90121-90200 (80 worlds, never used; the last of the reserved 90001-90200 block)

reference.what: frozen candidates/r3h-B: initial policy, KL anchor, rollback point (also installed and marked stable in cb2-ind-0001)

prereg.fixed: the scripted executor organ, the r2 core (frozen), the vision organ v1, the language stand-in; only the selector (and a value head) learns

learner.algorithm: PPO over the 8 organ commands, one command per step, + beta*KL(pi||pi_r3hB) per step + entropy bonus
learner.value_head: MLP on the detached selector trunk
learner.beta_rule: x2 if the iteration's mean KL to r3h-B > 1.5 * 0.02; /2 if < 0.02 / 1.5
learner.early_stop: an update stops when the approximate KL to the rollout policy exceeds 0.05
learner.sampling: temperature 1, a pure function of (iteration, life, step)

prereg.reward: training: reward['total'] - 10 * [terminal death step]; reported: the environment's own reward components, the penalty total per life, as before

red_flags_reported: training reward rising while development survival or requests fall
anti_hacking.added: 'hiding' check: command share of 'rest' and Crafter unlocks per life logged per iteration; the sealed score gate (>= 1.0x routine) and requests gate (>= 0.85x) make pure hiding fail

development.selection: the checkpoint with the best mean development survival among those whose development Crafter score >= r3h-B's; if none is eligible: no candidate, the sealed set is not opened

prereg.post_install_check: the installed s2b-final, under the unchanged cb2_evaluate, must reproduce its development life on 76001 (survival steps and unlocks); otherwise stop before the sealed set

arms: S2 candidate (paired with the routine on the same worlds, unchanged cb2_evaluate protocol)
sealed.bootstrap: paired per-world differences; one-sided 95% lower bound = 5th percentile of 10,000 bootstrap means, numpy default_rng(20261009)

verdicts.S2b_complete_beyond_routine: all of: (1) lower bound of paired survival (S2 - routine) > 0; (2) Crafter score >= 1.0x routine; (3) requests on time >= 0.85x the routine's rate (aggregate counts); (4) continuity as in r3-H (integrity, save/restore, consolidation round-trip, replay of 90041, 100% delegation provenance); no protocol deviation
verdicts.S2b_progress: if not complete: lower bound of paired survival (S2 - r3h-B) > 0 AND score >= r3h-B's score on the same worlds AND (3) AND (4)
verdicts.no_improvement: otherwise (reported as such; no post-hoc retuning on the sealed set)

prereg.integrity: any crash, missing world, corrupted artifact or protocol deviation is reported as such, never silently rerun
prereg.gate4: OPEN: S2 does not address prediction / persistent memory
prereg.power_note: S2 sealed: paired SD of survival vs the routine ~590 steps; with 80 worlds the one-sided 95% bound is ~1.645*590/sqrt(80) ~ 108 below the mean, so a true advantage of ~110 steps over the routine is needed to show 'complete'.

selection.rule: best development survival among checkpoints with development score >= r3h-B's (iteration 0)
